localizedValues.name: G2 - Karst Creek
localizedValues.description: Large and scenic group site with beach, mountain views and direct access to Buttle Lake. Site includes a level gravel area for RV’s and tents, a grassed area for play and tenting, and approximately 80 meters of sand and gravel beach. There is also a boat launch immediately adjacent to the group site. Potable water can be accessed by hand pump at Ralph River campground, approximately 5km away on highway. Boat trailers must be parked in group site, not in public stalls near boat launch.

localizedValues.name: G3 - Croteau Lake Backcountry
localizedValues.description: Croteau Lake Backcountry Group Site, completed in the Fall of 2017, is a remote hike-in site only,  located on Forbidden Plateau within Strathcona Provincial Park. It will take the average person approximately 1-1/2 to 2 hours to reach the site from the parking lot located at the Paradise Meadows trailhead (Adjacent to Mount Washington Alpine Resort's Nordic Raven Lodge). The trail is considered easy to moderate with trail surfaces ranging from boardwalk, to compact soil, to rocky sections. Depending on annual weather patterns, some portions of the trail may be wet and muddy or even compact snow in the Spring. Facilities at the site include a Yurt for socializing and eating, 12 raised wooden tent pads, two bear proof food caches, a small dock for accessing water, and a state-of-the-art composting toilet. The Yurt is equipped with a sink for washing (greywater drain) but no running water, folding tables and folding chairs. While day-hikers do wander past the area, the group site is the only facility on the lake and therefore not shared with other independent campers. Swimming is possible in the cool waters of the lake, but the shoreline is shallow at the group site location. There are excellent views of Mount Albert Edward, Castlecrag Mountain, Mount Frink and Mount Elma. Nearby lakes include: Kwai Lake (approximately 40 minute hike), Circlet Lake (1hr - 20 min), Lady Lake (15 min), Kooso Lake (30 min) and Battleship Lake (45 min).    For off-season use of this site, when reservations are not available, please contact BC Parks at 250 337-2405.
This is a first-come, first-served campsite. Site availability can only be confirmed in-person, at the park

localizedValues.name: G1 - Driftwood Bay
localizedValues.description: This large group site is ideally situated on Buttle Lake with lake access and separated from the campground. The beautiful log shelter accommodates large groups and is very popular for longer stays during the summer months. There is a bench overlooking the lake with a small beach area into Buttle Lake. It is very peaceful and beautiful here!
